build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems with PBC and soft or hard k-nearest neighbor ranking
build_chunked_radius_graph: build a chunked radius graph for a single atomic system to reduce peak memory during distance and ranking computation
compute_segment_argsort: compute the argsort of values within each segment using a vectorized cumsum-based approach for ranking edges by destination
compute_soft_ranks: compute soft ranks for a single padded segment of distances using a bump function for differentiable k-nearest neighbor approximation
run_batched_radius_graph: run batched radius graph construction across multiple atomic systems with optional chunking and pairwise distance computation
